exports: export type Priority = 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'  // exactly these three literals
export type Status = 'backlog' | 'in-progress' | 'review' | 'done'  // exactly these four literals

export interface Task { id: string; projectId: string; title: string; description: string; status: Status; priority: Priority; dueDate: string | null; assigneeId: string | null; labels: string[]; subtasks: Subtask[]; comments: Comment[]; createdAt: string; completedAt: string | null }  // labels/subtasks/comments default []
export interface Project { id: string; name: string; description: string; archived: boolean; createdAt: string }  // archived default false
export function generateId(prefix?: string): string  // prefix omitted -> no prefix; format `${prefix}-${counter}-${random}`; always non-empty and unique per call
export function toISODate(d: Date): string  // 'YYYY-MM-DD' local; invalid Date -> throws RangeError
export function parseISODate(s: string): Date  // local midnight; bad format -> throws RangeError
export function addDays(iso: string, n: number): string  // ISO shifted by n days; n===0 -> same
export function monthGrid(year: number, month: number): string[]  // length 42, starts Sunday on/before 1st; month 0-11 else RangeError
export function loadState(): AppState  // {projects: [], tasks: [], members: [], comments: [], settings: {theme: 'light', defaultProjectId: null}} when empty; corrupt JSON -> seeded state
export function saveState(state: AppState): void  // writes JSON; no-op when window undefined
export function resetState(): AppState  // clears key then returns seeded state
export function isSeeded(): boolean  // true when stored key exists and parses
export interface SeedData  // {projects: Project[], tasks: Task[], members: Member[], comments: Comment[], labels: Label[]}
export function createSeedData(): SeedData  // 3 projects, 12 tasks, 4 members, 6 comments, 5 labels; ids unique
files.purpose: Realistic seed data for first load.

exports: export interface Task  // {id: string, projectId: string, title: string, description: string, status: 'Backlog'|'In Progress'|'Review'|'Done', priority: 'low'|'medium'|'high', dueDate: string, assigneeId: string, labelIds: string[], subtasks: Subtask[], createdAt: string, completedAt: string|null}

export function createTask(tasks: Task[], input: {projectId: string, title: string, description?: string, priority?: 'low'|'medium'|'high', dueDate?: string, assigneeId?: string, labelIds?: string[]}): Task[]  // returns new array length+1; empty title -> throws Error
export function updateTask(tasks: Task[], id: string, patch: Partial<Omit<Task,'id'|'projectId'|'createdAt'>>): Task[]  // missing id -> same array; status->Done sets completedAt
export function filterTasks(tasks: Task[], filters: {assigneeId?: string, priority?: 'low'|'medium'|'high', status?: Task['status']}): Task[]  // no filters -> all tasks; subset preserving order
export interface Project {id: string; name: string; archived: boolean; createdAt: string}  // archived false on create
export function createProject(projects: Project[], name: string, id: string, now: string): Project[]  // length+1; name.trim()==='' -> throws Error('name required')
export function renameProject(projects: Project[], id: string, name: string): Project[]  // same length; unknown id -> unchanged; '' -> throws Error('name required')

export function projectProgress(projects: Project[], tasks: {projectId: string; status: string}[], id: string): {total: number; done: number; percent: number}  // percent 0 when total===0; unknown id -> {total:0,done:0,percent:0}

exports: export type Column = 'Backlog' | 'In Progress' | 'Review' | 'Done'  // fixed order
export const COLUMNS: Column[]  // ['Backlog','In Progress','Review','Done']

export function moveTask(tasks: {id: string; status: string; order: number}[], id: string, to: Column): {id: string; status: string; order: number}[]  // same length; moved item status===to and order===max+1 in target; unknown id -> unchanged

export function groupByColumn(tasks: {id: string; status: string; order: number}[]): Record<Column, {id: string; status: string; order: number}[]>  // each column sorted by order asc; empty input -> all four keys []

export function addSubtask(subtasks: Subtask[], title: string, id: string): Subtask[]  // length+1, appended {id,title,done:false}; empty title -> throws Error
export function toggleSubtask(subtasks: Subtask[], id: string): Subtask[]  // flips done of matching id; unknown id -> same array unchanged
export function removeSubtask(subtasks: Subtask[], id: string): Subtask[]  // length-1 without id; unknown id -> same array unchanged
files.purpose: Subtask add, toggle, and remove logic.

exports: export interface Comment { id: string; taskId: string; author: string; body: string; createdAt: string }  // one comment record
export function addComment(comments: Comment[], taskId: string, author: string, body: string, id: string, createdAt: string): Comment[]  // length+1, appended; empty body -> throws Error
export function listComments(comments: Comment[], taskId: string): Comment[]  // only matching taskId, input order; none -> []
export interface Label { id: string; name: string; color: string }  // color is a CSS hex string
export function createLabel(name: string, color: string): Label  // {id, name, color}; empty name -> throws Error
export function toggleLabel(labelIds: string[], labelId: string): string[]  // adds if absent, removes if present; length differs by exactly 1
export function labelsForTask(task: { labelIds: string[] }, all: Label[]): Label[]  // labels whose id is in task.labelIds, in all order; unknown ids skipped
export interface Member { id: string; name: string; role: string }  // role is a free-text job title
export function initials(name: string): string  // first letters of up to two words, uppercased; empty -> ''

export function workload(members: Member[], tasks: { assigneeId: string | null; status: string }[]): { memberId: string; open: number }[]  // one entry per member in input order; open counts tasks with that assigneeId and status !== 'Done'
export function memberById(members: Member[], id: string): Member | undefined  // undefined when no member has that id
export interface CalendarCell  // {date: string, inMonth: boolean, tasks: Task[]}

export function buildMonthGrid(year: number, month: number, tasks: Task[]): CalendarCell[]  // 42 cells, Sunday-first; month 1-12; month<1||>12 -> throws RangeError; tasks placed by dueDate, sorted by id
export function shiftMonth(year: number, month: number, delta: number): {year: number, month: number}  // month stays 1-12; month<1||>12 -> throws RangeError
export function monthLabel(year: number, month: number): string  // e.g. 'March 2025'; month<1||>12 -> throws RangeError
export interface BurndownPoint  // {date: string, remaining: number, ideal: number}

export function burndownSeries(tasks: Task[], startDate: string, endDate: string): BurndownPoint[]  // one point per day inclusive; startDate>endDate -> []; remaining counts tasks not done by that date; ideal linear from total to 0
export function totalScope(tasks: Task[]): number  // tasks.length; [] -> 0
export interface VelocityWeek { weekStart: string; completed: number }  // weekStart ISO yyyy-mm-dd Monday
export function velocityByWeek(tasks: Task[], weeks: number): VelocityWeek[]  // length===weeks, oldest first; weeks<=0 -> []; counts tasks with status 'Done' and completedAt in week
export function averageVelocity(weeks: VelocityWeek[]): number  // [] -> 0; mean of completed rounded to 2 decimals
export interface CycleStats { count: number; mean: number; median: number; min: number; max: number }  // all 0 when count===0
export function cycleTimeDays(task: Task): number | null  // null unless status 'Done' and both createdAt/completedAt set; else (completedAt-createdAt)/86400000 rounded 2dp
export function cycleStats(tasks: Task[]): CycleStats  // {count, mean, median, min, max}; ignores tasks with null cycleTime; count===0 -> all zeros
export interface SearchHit { kind: 'task' | 'project' | 'comment'; id: string; title: string; snippet: string; score: number }  // kind discriminates entity; score >= 0

export function searchAll(query: string, data: { tasks: { id: string; title: string; description: string }[]; projects: { id: string; name: string; description: string }[]; comments: { id: string; taskId: string; body: string }[] }): SearchHit[]  // query.trim()==='' -> []; case-insensitive substring; hits.length <= tasks+projects+comments; sorted by score desc

export function highlight(text: string, query: string): { text: string; match: boolean }[]  // query==='' -> [{text, match:false}]; concatenated text equals input; match true on case-insensitive occurrences

export function tasksToCsv(tasks: { id: string; title: string; status: string; priority: string; assigneeId: string | null; dueDate: string | null; labels: string[] }[]): string  // header row + one row per task; tasks.length===0 -> header only; fields with comma/quote/newline quoted and quotes doubled
export function csvEscape(value: string): string  // no special chars -> unchanged; contains , " or \n -> wrapped in quotes with " doubled
export type ActivityKind = 'task_created' | 'task_moved' | 'task_updated' | 'comment_added' | 'project_created' | 'project_renamed' | 'project_archived' | 'subtask_toggled'
export interface ActivityEntry { id: string; kind: ActivityKind; at: string; actor: string; summary: string; projectId: string | null; taskId: string | null }

export function deriveActivity(tasks: Task[], projects: Project[], comments: Comment[], limit: number): ActivityEntry[]  // newest first, length === min(limit, total events); limit<=0 -> []; missing project/task refs skipped
export function formatActivity(entry: ActivityEntry): string  // 'actor summary' trimmed; empty actor -> summary only
export type Theme = 'light' | 'dark'
export interface Settings { theme: Theme; defaultProjectId: string | null }
export function defaultSettings(): Settings  // {theme: 'light', defaultProjectId: null}
export function updateSettings(current: Settings, patch: Partial<Settings>): Settings  // merged copy; invalid theme -> throws RangeError; unknown defaultProjectId kept as given
